# Survival Parameter Estimates

For each sex-species dataset meeting the inclusion criteria of each of
the analytical approaches, the following variables are reported Class,
Species, Sex, AFR (Age at First Reproduction), Reliability Category
(Cat), L50_NP, L50CI_NP (95% confidence interval), L50_Par, L50CI_Par,
L90_NP, L90CI_NP, L90_Par, L90CI_Par, and sample size N. All survival
metrics are estimated from AFR. Raw metrics are not provided as they are
subject to bias for many species. According to Data Use Agreement
RR#96528 signed with Species360 for the use of ZIMS data, restriction
apply to the availability of the raw data used for this study.
Species360 member facilities retain ownership of the data they
contribute, and public release without explicit consent would violate
existing data-sharing agreements. For this reason, access to the raw
data is managed through a controlled data-sharing process. Species360
serves as the data repository for this study. Researchers interested in
accessing the raw data may submit a request through the Species360
Research Request process
(<https://conservation.species360.org/data-sharing/>) or contact the
Species360 Conservation Science Alliance by email, referencing the
Research Request number associated with this study (RR#96528).

The full dataset is available here: [Results Data](Main_Supp_tablesh.csv)
